settings.heading: A store you can actually trust

settings.text: Free delivery over your first threshold · 30-day returns

settings.heading: One trusted store for everything
settings.body: We started Emporium because shopping shouldn't mean ten tabs and ten checkouts. We bring quality picks from every department under one roof — curated, fairly priced and backed by real service.

settings.heading: Curated, not cluttered
settings.body: Every product earns its place. We test, compare and only stock things worth your money — so a big catalog still feels easy to shop.

settings.heading: One cart, one delivery
settings.body: Whatever mix of departments you order from, it ships together where we can — tracked door to door, with free delivery over your store's threshold.

blocks.question: How fast is delivery?
blocks.answer: In-stock orders are dispatched within 48 hours and delivered tracked. Delivery is free over your store's threshold, with express options at checkout.

blocks.question: What payment methods do you accept?
blocks.answer: All major cards, UPI, net banking and cash on delivery where available — all through an encrypted, secure checkout.

blocks.question: What is your returns policy?
blocks.answer: Return most items within 30 days for a full refund. Print the prepaid label, drop it off, and we'll refund you as soon as it reaches us.

blocks.question: Can I track my order?
blocks.answer: Yes — you'll get tracking by email and SMS the moment your order ships, and you can follow it from your account at any time.

blocks.question: Do you have a customer support team?
blocks.answer: We do — real people, seven days a week, by chat and email. If anything's not right, we'll make it right.
